scene.note: Live CARLA 0.9.x Town10HD IMU/GNSS recording. Each world.tick() advances 0.04 s of sensor time and emits two IMU samples 0.02 s apart, so the requested 100 Hz sensor_tick yields a 50 Hz effective stream. The first 100 ticks are warm-up and discarded. Town10HD has no modelled road defects, so calibrated vertical impulses are applied to the ego vehicle at the times listed in ground_truth; the IMU stream itself is genuine CARLA physics output, not a synthesised signal.
